Browser profile configuration persists and reuses browser state across crawl sessions

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"},\"browser_profile\":\"test-profile\"}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.browserUsed())
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
```
